review.posthog_relevance: Billing and row tracking setup for warehouse extraction, potentially exempting free-tier sources from billing checks.
review.reason: Adds a helper function to check warehouse source age against a free historical window and imports this check and row tracking setup into the extraction module. This establishes the billing and row tracking infrastructure, though the complete implementation and billing enforcement are not shown. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and setup change.
review.uncertainty: The tier cannot be established with high confidence because the complete implementation of the billing limit check and row tracking setup is not shown; the tier is established based on the extraction and billing checks, not the full implementation.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the billing limit check or the row tracking setup, only the extraction and billing checks. The billing and row tracking implementation is not shown, so the tier cannot be established.
